mapper.sql: hw_id, std_id, c_id, teacher_id, title, content, type, total_score, deadline, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM my_homework WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM my_student_homework sh INNER JOIN my_homework h ON h.hw_id = sh.hw_id WHERE h.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND sh.status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_homework (std_id, c_id, teacher_id, title, content, type, total_score, deadline, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{stdId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{homeworkName}, #{content}, #{type}, #{totalScore}, #{deadline}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO my_homework (std_id, c_id, teacher_id, title, content, type, total_score, deadline, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{h.stdId}, #{h.courseId}, #{h.teacherId}, #{h.homeworkName}, #{h.content}, #{h.type}, #{h.totalScore}, #{h.deadline}, #{h.status}, NOW(), NOW())
